prompt: Which U.S. National Park was the first to be established after the Portland Trail Blazers won their only playoff series with LaMarcus Aldridge on the team?
answer: **Gateway Arch National Park** in St. Louis, Missouri, was the first U.S. national park established after the Portland Trail Blazers won their 2014 first-round series against the Houston Rockets—their only playoff-series victory during LaMarcus Aldridge’s Portland tenure. It was designated a national park on **February 22, 2018**.
